title: UPSSSC OTR Registration Online Form 2021
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Open One Time Registration
3. Fill personal and educational details
4. Upload photo and signature
5. Generate OTR number for all UPSSSC exams
shortDescription: UPSSSC OTR Registration – mandatory One Time Registration on upsssc.gov.in before applying to PET-based exams.
content:
UPSSSC One Time Registration (OTR) is required for candidates appearing in UPSSSC examinations linked with Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) and subsequent recruitments.

Create OTR once, keep the number safe, and use it for all future applications. Portal: upsssc.gov.in.
